name: bollinger_band_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY closes below its 5-minute Bollinger lower band (60-bar, 2σ), algorithmic sell programs have driven price beyond the normal micro-volatility range, exhausting near-term sell-side liquidity at that depth. Market makers net-short gamma from option selling immediately begin delta-hedging by buying NIFTY futures, and VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks see fills significantly better than their benchmark and start accumulating. This reactive buying typically pushes NIFTY back toward the 5-minute SMA within 30-90 seconds, covering 10-15 spot points of reversion. The converse holds at the upper band: overbought micro-conditions trigger gamma-hedgers selling futures and profit-taking from momentum players, producing a downward reversion to the midline.

indicators.name: bb_mid_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute SMA on NIFTY. Original used 20-bar 1-min (20 minutes); compressed to 5 minutes because we hold 15-90s and want to detect micro-overextensions at a timescale 3-5x our hold time, not 20x. A 5-min window captures intraday micro-regime drift without being too noisy at 5s resolution.

indicators.name: bb_upper_60
indicators.purpose: Upper band: 2σ threshold marks overbought micro-conditions where gamma-hedging sell flow kicks in. 2σ preserved from original; at 5s bars on NIFTY, tighter (1.5σ) fires too often on noise, looser (2.5σ) is rarely triggered.

indicators.name: bb_lower_60
indicators.purpose: Lower band: marks oversold micro-conditions on NIFTY where institutional buy flow and gamma-hedging accumulation typically initiates within 30-90 seconds.

indicators.name: vol_avg_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute volume baseline. Volume surge > 1.5x average confirms real order flow is driving the band breach rather than a quiet drift on thin liquidity. Directly adapted from original's volume > 1.5 * avg_20 filter.

buy_ce.confirmation: Both conditions satisfied on the same 5-second bar

buy_pe.confirmation: Both conditions satisfied on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: If NIFTY continues past the Bollinger Band by another ~8 spot points (4 option pts at delta 0.5) the breach is a breakout, not a reversion — gamma-hedging buy flow has failed to hold and a trend is forming. Exiting here prevents a 1-band-width loss from becoming a 2-3 band-width loss.
exit.target_rationale: NIFTY's 5-min BB midline sits ~12-15 spot points from the band edge in typical vol conditions; 6 option points captures roughly 60% of that reversion (1:1.5 R:R) without requiring a full mean reversion which is slower and risks time-stop.

filters.vix_filter: none — strategy fires on short-term BB breach regardless of regime
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; first 60 bars skipped for BB warmup

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — mean reversion edges on indices weaken during strong trend days and macro event sessions

adaptation_notes: Original used 20-bar BB on 1-min equity bars (20-min lookback) with 1-10 min holds. Key changes: (1) Lookback compressed from 20 min to 5 min (60 bars at 5s) — we hold 15-90s, not 1-10 min; detecting micro-overextensions requires a shorter reference window; (2) Volume filter preserved at the same 1.5x ratio but applied to 60-bar avg instead of 20-bar avg to match the same 5-minute baseline; (3) Stop redesigned in option premium points calibrated to NIFTY micro-moves — the original 0.4% equity stop becomes 4 option pts (2 NIFTY sigma continuation); (4) Target set at 6 option pts (midline partial reversion) instead of the original's full BB midline target, which takes too long at 5s; (5) Mechanism reframed around NIFTY-specific gamma-hedging and VWAP-benchmarked institutional behavior on the index.
weaknesses: Strong trending days (budget, Fed events, VIX spike) cause repeated band breaches that never revert, burning stop losses systematically
At 5-second resolution, noisy candles near the band can fire multiple overlapping signals on the same move (whipsaw cost)
NIFTY volume at 5s is thin and lumpy; the volume filter may not reliably separate institutional order flow from microstructure noise
